subject: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bolton <sara.bolton@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP

Hi Sara —

Following up from last week's demo: we want to formalize the mutual action plan and make sure we have the right executive advocates and an EB (executive briefing) cadence locked in as part of the close plan. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an evaluation plan template.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm who your executive sponsor(s) will be (name + title + preferred availability window)?
- Do you prefer weekly 30m EB syncs or bi-weekly 45m check-ins during the evaluation window?
- Any procurement / legal milestones we should map into the MAP timeline now?

If it's helpful, we can propose a 6-week evaluation MAP with two EB checkpoints (kickoff + mid-eval + final readout). I’ll loop in Karthik and Lauren to align on internal exec coverage.

Thanks —
Rafael
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Evaluation_Plan_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Sara Bolton <sara.bolton@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP

Thanks Rafael — helpful start. A couple quick notes:

- Executive sponsor: Dr. Elena Marquez, SVP Product Strategy (elena.marquez@nimbushealth.com). She prefers late mornings (10–11am PT) and can join the kickoff + final readout.
- Advocate: Samir will be the day-to-day technical advocate and will run the evaluation with our clinical data team.
- Evaluation window: we want 4 weeks (short runway) — kickoff week of Apr 5, final readout week of May 3. Mid-eval checkpoint around Apr 19 looks good.
- Procurement: we have a standard PO workflow; procurement needs a pricing appendix and our legal team will review SOWs. They estimate 2–3 weeks after final readout.

Please update the MAP with those dates and sponsor details. Also, can Redwood provide an agenda template for the EB meetings (kickoff / mid / final)?

– Sara
Director, Clinical Programs
Nimbus Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP

Looping in Lauren and Marissa to agree on exec coverage. Rafael — I updated the attached MAP with Elena as exec sponsor and the 4-week evaluation timeline Sara suggested. I also drafted an EB agenda template (short, outcomes-focused):

Kickoff (30m): objectives, success criteria, roles & responsibilities, data access checklist, evaluation milestones
Mid-eval (30m): progress vs success criteria, blockers, data observations, next steps
Final readout (45m): demo of results, recommended rollout path, procurement/contract next steps

Notes and asks for internal team:
- Lauren: can you take point on booking Elena for kickoff + final? She prefers 10–11am PT.
- Marissa: can you prepare the pricing appendix & SOW talking points so procurement has what they need post-readout?

I also added two gating items to the MAP: security questionnaire completion and an integration data access checklist.

Karthik
Enterprise Solutions
From: Sara Bolton <sara.bolton@nimbushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP

Thanks Karthik — that agenda looks good. A couple of timings to confirm:

- Kickoff: Tue Apr 6, 10:30–11:00am PT (Elena can do 10:30 on that day)
- Mid-eval: Mon Apr 19, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Final readout: Tue May 4, 10:00–10:45am PT (we need this after internal clinical signoff)

On procurement: procurement@nimbushealth.com asked for the pricing appendix PDF and the draft SOW (word doc) so they can get an initial review started. They also requested a short summary slide with the evaluation success criteria for their internal stakeholders.

I’ll accept calendar invites once we have the final attachments.

— Sara
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Bolton <sara.bolton@nimbushealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate & EB meeting rhythm for Nimbus MAP

All — locking calendar invites now. Rafael / Marissa, I attached the requested pricing appendix (PDF) and a one-slide evaluation-summary (as discussed). Rafael: can you upload the final MAP + evaluation plan to the shared Drive folder and send the DocuSign SOW link to procurement after the final readout?

ACTION ITEMS:
- Rafael: upload Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (final) + Evaluation_Plan_v1.pdf to Drive and paste link in thread.
- Marissa: finalize pricing appendix and prepare draft SOW for DocuSign.
- Karthik: confirm EB host list and run deck template for kickoff.

I'll send the invites for: Apr 6 10:30–11:00 (kickoff), Apr 19 10:00–10:30 (mid-eval), May 4 10:00–10:45 (final).

Thanks —
Lauren

Redwood Inference
